main.description: In an encrypted share: one member's keys. The record key is the member's DID. Written by the share's owner only.

keyring.description: The share's keyring, wrapped (HPKE auth mode) for the member's published sharing key, from the owner's: the member accepts it only if the sender is the key the owner published.

membership.description: {did, publicKey}: who it's for, sealed with the share's current key for this record, so the PDS can't make one or bring back a removed member's.
